      expect(metaFake.enviados).toHaveLength(1);
      const failed = await prisma.message.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { buId: A.businessUnit.id, direction: 'OUT', externalId: null } });
      expect(failed).toMatchObject({ status: 'FALHOU', content: 'resposta incerta', authorName: 'Parceiro' });
      metaFake.sendIdNull = false;
    });

    it('fora da janela, POST messages recusa com JANELA_FECHADA', async () => {
      await prisma.message.updateMany({ data: { createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - 25 * 60 * 60 * 1000) } });
      const res = await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .post('/api/v1/messages').set(comChave(chaveA))
        .send({ account_id: A.businessUnit.id, telefone: CONTATO, texto: 'tarde demais' })
        .expect(409);
      expect(res.body.code).toBe('JANELA_FECHADA');
      expect(metaFake.enviados).toHaveLength(0);
    });

    it('não usa canal alternativo quando a origem selecionada está desconectada', async () => {
      const canalOficial = await prisma.buChannel.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { buId: A.businessUnit.id, type: 'OFICIAL' },
        select: { id: true },
      });
      await criarCanalVerificado(prisma, A.businessUnit.id, 'NAO_OFICIAL', 'public-ready-alternative', { requiresWindow: false });
      await prisma.buChannel.update({ where: { id: canalOficial.id }, data: { status: 'DESCONECTADO' } });

      const list = await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .get(`/api/v1/conversations?account_id=${A.businessUnit.id}`)
        .set(comChave(chaveA)).expect(200);
      expect(list.body.conversations[0]).toMatchObject({
        envio_disponivel: false,
        motivo_indisponibilidade: 'CHANNEL_NOT_READY',
      });

      const thread = await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .get(`/api/v1/conversations/${CONTATO}/messages?account_id=${A.businessUnit.id}`)
        .set(comChave(chaveA)).expect(200);
      expect(thread.body).toMatchObject({
        envio_disponivel: false,
        motivo_indisponibilidade: 'CHANNEL_NOT_READY',
      });

      const providerCallsBefore = { meta: metaFake.providerCalls, evolution: evolutionFake.providerCalls };
      const outBefore = await prisma.message.count({ where: { buId: A.businessUnit.id, direction: 'OUT' } });
      const blocked = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/api/v1/messages').set(comChave(chaveA))
        .send({ account_id: A.businessUnit.id, telefone: CONTATO, texto: 'não deve trocar de canal' }).expect(409);
      expect(blocked.body.code).toBe('CHANNEL_NOT_READY');
      expect(metaFake.providerCalls).toBe(providerCallsBefore.meta);
      expect(evolutionFake.providerCalls).toBe(providerCallsBefore.evolution);
      expect(await prisma.message.count({ where: { buId: A.businessUnit.id, direction: 'OUT' } })).toBe(outBefore);
    });
  });

  describe('limites de paginação pública', () => {
    const partitions = [
      { label: 'omitted', suffix: '', listExpected: 200, historyExpected: 100 },
      { label: 'blank', suffix: '&limit=', listExpected: 200, historyExpected: 100 },
      { label: 'nonfinite', suffix: '&limit=Infinity', listExpected: 200, historyExpected: 100 },
      { label: 'zero', suffix: '&limit=0', listExpected: 200, historyExpected: 100 },
      { label: 'sub-one fractional', suffix: '&limit=0.5', listExpected: 200, historyExpected: 100 },
      { label: 'positive fractional', suffix: '&limit=17.8', listExpected: 17, historyExpected: 17 },
      { label: 'exact cap', suffix: '&limit=500', listExpected: 500, historyExpected: 500 },
      { label: 'over cap', suffix: '&limit=900', listExpected: 500, historyExpected: 500 },
      { label: 'integer 17', suffix: '&limit=17', listExpected: 17, historyExpected: 17 },
      { label: 'negative million', suffix: '&limit=-1000000', listExpected: 200, historyExpected: 100 },
      { label: 'repeated', suffix: '&limit=17&limit=18', listExpected: 200, historyExpected: 100 },
    ] as const;

    function sqlTake(event: { query: string; params: string }): number | undefined {
      const limitParameter = event.query.match(/\bLIMIT\s+\$(\d+)/i);
      if (!limitParameter) return undefined;
      const params = JSON.parse(event.params) as unknown[];
      const value = params[Number(limitParameter[1]) - 1];
      return typeof value === 'number' ? value : undefined;
    }

    it.each(partitions)('normalizes $label list input through the executed PostgreSQL query', async ({ suffix, listExpected }) => {
      const start = queryEvents.length;
      const response = await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .get(`/api/v1/conversations?account_id=${A.businessUnit.id}${suffix}`).set(comChave(chaveA));
      expect(response.status, JSON.stringify(response.body)).toBe(200);
      const executed = queryEvents.slice(start).filter((event) => event.query.includes('FROM "public"."conversations"') && /\bLIMIT\s+\$\d+/i.test(event.query));
      expect(executed).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(executed.map(sqlTake)).toEqual([listExpected + 1]);
    });

    it.each(partitions)('normalizes $label history input through the executed PostgreSQL query', async ({ suffix, historyExpected }) => {
      const start = queryEvents.length;
      const response = await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .get(`/api/v1/conversations/${CONTATO}/messages?account_id=${A.businessUnit.id}${suffix}`).set(comChave(chaveA));
      expect(response.status, JSON.stringify(response.body)).toBe(200);
      const executed = queryEvents.slice(start).filter((event) => event.query.includes('FROM "public"."messages"') &&
        /"public"\."messages"\."message_type"/i.test(event.query) && /\bLIMIT\s+\$\d+/i.test(event.query));
      expect(executed).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(executed.map(sqlTake)).toEqual([historyExpected]);
    });

    it('preserves the parent lookahead when a list has another conversation', async () => {
      await prisma.conversation.create({ data: {
        buId: A.businessUnit.id, contact: '5584911112233', contactType: 'PESSOA', status: 'QUEUED',
        lastMessageAt: new Date(Date.now() + 10_000),
      } });
      const start = queryEvents.length;
      const response = await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .get(`/api/v1/conversations?account_id=${A.businessUnit.id}&limit=1`).set(comChave(chaveA)).expect(200);
      const executed = queryEvents.slice(start).filter((event) => event.query.includes('FROM "public"."conversations"') && /\bLIMIT\s+\$\d+/i.test(event.query));
      expect(executed.map(sqlTake)).toEqual([2]);
      expect(response.body.conversations).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(response.body.truncado).toBe(true);
      expect(response.body.conversations[0]).toMatchObject({ ultima_mensagem: null, ultima_direcao: null });
    });
  });

  describe('limite de taxa (ADR-0010 §7) — fecha o buraco de ritmo do S3', () => {
    it('estoura em 429 LIMITE_DE_TAXA com Retry-After', async () => {
      const enviar = () =>
        request(app.getHttpServer())
          .post('/api/v1/messages').set(comChave(chaveA))
          .send({ account_id: A.businessUnit.id, telefone: CONTATO, texto: 'em rajada' });

      const limite = Number(process.env.API_V1_ENVIOS_POR_MINUTO ?? 20);
      for (let i = 0; i < limite; i++) await enviar().expect(201);

      const estourou = await enviar().expect(429);
      expect(estourou.body.code).toBe('LIMITE_DE_TAXA');
      expect(estourou.headers['retry-after']).toBeTruthy();
      expect(metaFake.enviados).toHaveLength(limite);
    });
  });
});

const { Test } = require('@nestjs/testing');

  process.env.EVOLUTION_API_KEY = 'timeline-provider-port-only';
  process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET = 'timeline-evolution-header-secret';
  process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/webhooks/evolution';
  process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID = 'timeline-key-v1';

    const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${fixturePort}${path}`, {

      body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
    });

  const tokenPermitido = async (accessToken) => {

  };
  const providerResources = async (accessToken) => {
    if (!/^timeline-(?:scoped-token|code-token):[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(accessToken ?? '')) throw new Error('scoped credential required');
    let all = await fixture('/provider/resources');
    if (accessToken.startsWith('timeline-scoped-token:')) return all.filter((r) => r.id === accessToken.slice('timeline-scoped-token:'.length));
    if (accessToken.startsWith('timeline-code-token:')) {
      const encoded = accessToken.slice('timeline-code-token:'.length); const code = Buffer.from(encoded, 'base64url').toString(); const state = await fixture('/provider/state');
      const ids = state.meta.grantResourceIds?.[code]; if (!Array.isArray(ids)) throw new Error('unknown fixture grant');
      all = all.filter((r) => ids.includes(r.id));

''); const state = await fixture('/provider/state'); if (!Object.hasOwn(state.meta.grantResourceIds ?? {}, safeCode)) throw new Error('unknown fixture authorization grant'); return { accessToken: `timeline-code-token:${Buffer.from(safeCode).toString('base64url')}` }; },

      await call('meta.resources', { wabaId: wabaId ?? null, after: after ?? null });
      const all = await providerResources(accessToken);
      const wabas = [...new Map(all.map((r) => [r.wabaId, { id: r.wabaId, name: r.wabaName ?? null }])).values()];
      if (!wabaId) return { wabas, numbers: [], next: null };
      const state = await fixture('/provider/state');
      const key = `${wabaId}:${after ?? ''}`;
      const page = state.meta.pages?.[key];
      let data = all.filter((r) => r.wabaId === wabaId);
      if (page) data = data.filter((r) => (page.ids ?? []).includes(r.id));
      const next = page?.next ?? null;
      return { wabas: [{ id: wabaId, name: wabas.find((w) => w.id === wabaId)?.name ?? null }], numbers: data.map(({ id, telefone }) => ({ id, telefone, nomeVerificado: 'Fixture number' })), next };
    },

      await call('meta.confirm', { wabaId, phoneNumberId, after: after ?? null });

    },

      if (!(await tokenPermitido(accessToken))) throw new Error('scoped credential required');
      const authorized = (await providerResources(accessToken)).some((r) => r.wabaId === wabaId);
      if (!authorized) return null;
      await call('meta.confirm', { wabaId, phoneNumberId, after: null });
      const seen = new Set(); let after = null;
      for (let index = 0; index < 2; index += 1) {
        const page = await this.numerosDaWaba(wabaId, accessToken, after);
        const number = page.data.find((item) => item.id === phoneNumberId);
        if (number) return number;
        if (!page.next) return null;
        if (page.next.length > 512 || seen.has(page.next) || index === 1) throw new MetaIndisponivelError('A verificação do número está inconclusiva.');
        seen.add(page.next); after = page.next;
      }
      throw new MetaIndisponivelError('A verificação do número está inconclusiva.');
    },
    async registrarNumero(id, _pin, accessToken) { if (!(await tokenPermitido(accessToken))) throw new Error('scoped credential required'); await call('meta.register', { phoneNumberId: id }); await fixture('/provider/effect', 'POST', { operation: 'meta.register', args: { phoneNumberId: id } }); },
    async inscreverWaba(id, accessToken) { if (!(await tokenPermitido(accessToken))) throw new Error('scoped credential required'); await call('meta.subscribe', { wabaId: id }); await fixture('/provider/effect', 'POST', { operation: 'meta.subscribe', args: { wabaId: id } }); },
    async enviarTexto(phoneNumberId, _contato, texto, accessToken) {
      const permitted = accessToken === `timeline-scoped-token:${phoneNumberId}`
        || (await providerResources(accessToken)).some((r) => r.id === phoneNumberId);
      if (!permitted) throw new Error('verified scoped resource required');
      await call('meta.send', { phoneNumberId }); metaFake.enviados.push(texto);
      const state = await fixture('/provider/state');
      return state.meta.sendMode === 'unknown'
        ? { outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', legacyCode: 'META_RECUSOU' }
        : { outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: `timeline-wamid-${metaFake.enviados.length}` };
    },
    enviados: [],
  };
  const evolutionInventory = new Map();
  const evolutionFake = {
    configurado: () => true,
    async criarInstancia(name) {
      const channel = await fixturePrisma.buChannel.findFirst({ where: { evolutionInstanceName: name }, select: { id: true, buId: true, generation: true, pairingEpoch: true, currentAttemptId: true } });
      const result = await fixture('/provider/evolution/create', 'POST', { name, channelId: channel?.id, attemptId: channel?.currentAttemptId, generation: channel?.generation, pairingEpoch: channel?.pairingEpoch });
      evolutionInventory.set(name, result.instance); return { qrcode: result.instance.qrcode };
    },
    async qrDaInstancia(name) { await call('evolution.qr', { name }); const observed = await fixture('/provider/evolution/observe', 'POST', { name }); return observed?.qrcode ?? null; },
    async estadoDaInstancia(name) { const observed = await fixture('/provider/evolution/observe', 'POST', { name }); return observed?.connectionStatus ?? 'close'; },
    async consultarInstancia(name) { return fixture('/provider/evolution/observe', 'POST', { name }); },
    async apagarInstancia(name) { await fixture('/provider/evolution/delete', 'POST', { name }); evolutionInventory.delete(name); },
    async enviarTexto(name, contact, text) {
      const observed = await fixture('/provider/evolution/observe', 'POST', { name }); if (!observed) throw new Error('unknown exact instance');
      const state = await fixture('/provider/state'); await call('evolution.send', { name });

      if (state.evolution.echoInsideSend === true) {

        const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${process.env.PORT ?? '3100'}/webhooks/evolution`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-leadshug-webhook-secret': process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });

import { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import request from 'supertest';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { PrismaService } from '../src/infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { sealChannelCredential } from '../src/domain/channels/channel-credential-crypto';
import { OutboundService } from '../src/domain/inbox/outbound.service';
import { Channel, type ChannelSendResult, type TextMessage } from '../src/domain/channels/transport/channel';
import { ChannelAdapterFactory } from '../src/integrations/channels/channel-adapter-factory';
import { ChannelAdapterRegistry } from '../src/integrations/channels/channel-adapter-registry';
import type { ResolvedChannelCredential } from '../src/domain/channels/channel-credential-resolver';
import { MetaChannelFactory } from '../src/integrations/channels/meta-channel';
import { EvolutionChannelFactory } from '../src/integrations/channels/evolution-channel';
import { MetaHttpClient } from '../src/integrations/meta/meta.client';
import {
  contratarCanalNaoOficial, criarCanalVerificado, criarMantenedora, evolutionFake, limparBanco, login, metaFake, subirApp,
} from './helpers';

class OpaqueRecipientChannel extends Channel {
  constructor(private readonly sent: TextMessage[]) { super(); }
  async sendMessage(message: TextMessage): Promise<ChannelSendResult> {
    this.sent.push(message);
    return { outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: `opaque-fake-${this.sent.length}` };
  }
}

class OpaqueRecipientFactory extends ChannelAdapterFactory {
  readonly origin = 'OFICIAL' as const;
  constructor(private readonly sent: TextMessage[]) { super(); }
  locallyConfigured() { return true; }
  create() { return new OpaqueRecipientChannel(this.sent); }
}

class MutatingMetaFactory extends ChannelAdapterFactory {
  readonly origin = 'OFICIAL' as const;
  private readonly delegate = new MetaChannelFactory(metaFake);
  constructor(private readonly mutateBeforeFence: () => Promise<void>) { super(); }
  locallyConfigured() { return this.delegate.locallyConfigured(); }
  create(credential: ResolvedChannelCredential, beforeDispatch: () => Promise<boolean>) {
    return this.delegate.create(credential, async () => {
      await this.mutateBeforeFence();
      return beforeDispatch();
    });
  }
}

class MutatingEvolutionFactory extends ChannelAdapterFactory {
  readonly origin = 'NAO_OFICIAL' as const;
  private readonly delegate = new EvolutionChannelFactory(evolutionFake);
  constructor(private readonly mutateBeforeFence: () => Promise<void>) { super(); }
  locallyConfigured() { return this.delegate.locallyConfigured(); }
  create(credential: ResolvedChannelCredential, beforeDispatch: () => Promise<boolean>) {
    return this.delegate.create(credential, async () => {
      await this.mutateBeforeFence();
      return beforeDispatch();
    });
  }
}

describe('common Channel outbound (PostgreSQL)', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  let prisma: PrismaService;
  let buId: string;
  let conversationId: string;
  let identityId: string;
  let cookie: string;

  beforeAll(async () => { ({ app, prisma } = await subirApp()); });
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await limparBanco(prisma);
    const tenant = await criarMantenedora(app, 'Channel outbound fixture', 'channel-outbound@example.test');
    buId = tenant.businessUnit.id;
    const binding = await criarCanalVerificado(prisma, buId, 'OFICIAL', '987654321', { requiresWindow: false });
    identityId = binding.identity.id;
    const conversation = await prisma.conversation.create({ data: {
      buId, contact: 'user:opaque', contactType: 'PESSOA', displayName: 'Opaque recipient', status: 'QUEUED',
    } });
    conversationId = conversation.id;
    cookie = await login(app, 'channel-outbound@example.test');
  });
  afterAll(async () => { if (prisma) await limparBanco(prisma); await app?.close(); });

  it('sends a trusted opaque recipient through one bound adapter and finalizes without stealing a later owner', async () => {
    const gate = await prisma.conversation.update({ where: { id: conversationId }, data: {
      status: 'IN_SERVICE', attendantName: 'Claim before send', attendantOrigin: 'INTERNO',
    } });
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversationId}/messages`)
      .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({ texto: 'opaque recipient test' }).expect(201);
    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({ canal: 'OFICIAL' });
    expect(metaFake.enviados).toEqual([{ para: 'user:opaque', texto: 'opaque recipient test' }]);
    const message = await prisma.message.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { conversationId, direction: 'OUT' } });
    expect(message).toMatchObject({ externalId: expect.any(String), content: 'opaque recipient test', authorUserId: expect.any(String) });
    const finalized = await prisma.conversation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: gate.id } });
    expect(finalized).toMatchObject({ attendantName: 'Claim before send', attendantOrigin: 'INTERNO' });
  });

  it('runs an opaque user recipient through an independent Channel fake and never calls provider clients', async () => {
    const sent: TextMessage[] = [];
    const registry = new ChannelAdapterRegistry([new OpaqueRecipientFactory(sent)]);
    const isolated = await subirApp(registry);
    try {
      await limparBanco(isolated.prisma);
      const tenant = await criarMantenedora(isolated.app, 'Opaque fake contract', 'opaque-fake@example.test');
      const localBuId = tenant.businessUnit.id;
      await criarCanalVerificado(isolated.prisma, localBuId, 'OFICIAL', 'opaque-fake-resource', { requiresWindow: false });
      const localConversation = await isolated.prisma.conversation.create({ data: {
        buId: localBuId, contact: 'user:opaque', contactType: 'PESSOA', displayName: 'Opaque fake recipient', status: 'QUEUED',
      } });

  it('blocks real binding changes inside Meta/Evolution adapter pre-dispatch callbacks', async () => {
    const cases = [
      { provider: 'OFICIAL' as const, changed: 'generation' as const },
      { provider: 'OFICIAL' as const, changed: 'pairingEpoch' as const },
      { provider: 'OFICIAL' as const, changed: 'credentialVersion' as const },
      { provider: 'NAO_OFICIAL' as const, changed: 'generation' as const },
      { provider: 'NAO_OFICIAL' as const, changed: 'pairingEpoch' as const },
    ];
    for (const { provider, changed } of cases) {
      let mutate!: () => Promise<void>;
      const previousModuleSwitch = process.env.LH_CHANNEL_UNOFFICIAL;
      if (provider === 'NAO_OFICIAL') process.env.LH_CHANNEL_UNOFFICIAL = 'true';
      const registry = new ChannelAdapterRegistry([provider === 'OFICIAL'
        ? new MutatingMetaFactory(() => mutate())
        : new MutatingEvolutionFactory(() => mutate())]);
      const isolated = await subirApp(registry);
      try {
        await limparBanco(isolated.prisma);
        const tenant = await criarMantenedora(isolated.app, `Pre-dispatch ${changed}`, `pre-dispatch-${changed}@example.test`);
        if (provider === 'NAO_OFICIAL') {
          await contratarCanalNaoOficial(isolated.prisma, tenant.mantenedora.id);
        }
        const localBinding = await criarCanalVerificado(isolated.prisma, tenant.businessUnit.id, provider,
          `pre-dispatch-${provider}-${changed}`, { requiresWindow: false });
        const localConversation = await isolated.prisma.conversation.create({ data: {
          buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, contact: `user:opaque-${provider}-${changed}`, contactType: 'PESSOA', status: 'QUEUED',
        } });
        const localCookie = await login(isolated.app, `pre-dispatch-${changed}@example.test`);
        let changedOnce = false;
        mutate = async () => {
          if (changedOnce) return;
          changedOnce = true;
          if (changed === 'generation') {
            await isolated.prisma.buChannel.update({ where: { id: localBinding.channel.id }, data: { generation: { increment: 1 } } });
          } else if (changed === 'pairingEpoch') {
            await isolated.prisma.buChannel.update({ where: { id: localBinding.channel.id }, data: { pairingEpoch: { increment: 1 } } });
          } else {
            await isolated.prisma.channelCredential.update({ where: { channelId: localBinding.channel.id }, data: { version: { increment: 1 } } });
          }
        };
        const metaCallsBefore = metaFake.providerCalls;
        const evolutionCallsBefore = evolutionFake.providerCalls;
        await request(isolated.app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/conversations/${localConversation.id}/messages`)
          .set('Cookie', localCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({ texto: `blocked ${changed}` })
          .expect(409).expect(({ body }) => expect(body).toMatchObject({ code: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED', outcome: 'BLOCKED' }));
        expect(await isolated.prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId: localConversation.id, direction: 'OUT' } })).toBe(0);
        expect(metaFake.providerCalls).toBe(metaCallsBefore);
        expect(evolutionFake.providerCalls).toBe(evolutionCallsBefore);
      } finally {
        await limparBanco(isolated.prisma);
        await isolated.app.close();
        if (previousModuleSwitch === undefined) delete process.env.LH_CHANNEL_UNOFFICIAL;
        else process.env.LH_CHANNEL_UNOFFICIAL = previousModuleSwitch;
      }
    }
  });

  it('persists nothing for contradictory successful Meta envelopes', async () => {

      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ok: true, status: 200, json: async () => ({ success: false, messages: [{}] }) });
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchFake);
    const isolated = await subirApp(new ChannelAdapterRegistry([new MetaChannelFactory(new MetaHttpClient())]));
    try {
      await limparBanco(isolated.prisma);
      const tenant = await criarMantenedora(isolated.app, 'Contradictory Meta ACK', 'contradictory-meta@example.test');
      await criarCanalVerificado(isolated.prisma, tenant.businessUnit.id, 'OFICIAL', 'contradictory-meta-resource', { requiresWindow: false });
      const conversation = await isolated.prisma.conversation.create({ data: {
        buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, contact: 'user:opaque', contactType: 'PESSOA', status: 'QUEUED',
      } });
      const session = await login(isolated.app, 'contradictory-meta@example.test');

        await request(isolated.app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversation.id}/messages`)
          .set('Cookie', session).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({ texto: `contradictory result ${requestIndex}` })
          .expect(400).expect(({ body }) => expect(body).toMatchObject({
            outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'TRANSPORT_UNCONFIRMED',
          }));
        expect((await request(isolated.app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversation.id}/messages`)
          .set('Cookie', session)).body.messages.filter((message: { direction: string }) => message.direction === 'OUT')).toHaveLength(0);
        expect(fetchFake).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(requestIndex);
        expect(await isolated.prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId: conversation.id, direction: 'OUT' } })).toBe(0);
      }
    } finally {
      vi.unstubAllGlobals();
      await limparBanco(isolated.prisma);
      await isolated.app.close();
    }
  });

  it('holds two tenants in flight with distinct scoped resources and credentials', async () => {
    const tenantB = await criarMantenedora(app, 'Parallel tenant B', 'parallel-tenant-b@example.test');
    const channelA = await prisma.buChannel.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { buId, type: 'OFICIAL' } });
    const bindingA = {
      channel: channelA,
      identity: await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { currentChannelId: channelA.id } }),
    };
    const bindingB = await criarCanalVerificado(prisma, tenantB.businessUnit.id, 'OFICIAL', 'parallel-resource-b', { requiresWindow: false });
    const credentialA = await prisma.channelCredential.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { channelId: bindingA.channel.id } });
    const credentialB = await prisma.channelCredential.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { channelId: bindingB.channel.id } });
    const key = Buffer.from(process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY!, 'base64');
    const tokenA = 'tenant-a-distinct-scoped-token';
    const tokenB = 'tenant-b-distinct-scoped-token';
    for (const [binding, credential, token] of [[bindingA, credentialA, tokenA], [bindingB, credentialB, tokenB]] as const) {
      const envelope = sealChannelCredential(token, credential.keyId, key, {
        purpose: 'active', provider: 'OFICIAL', buId: binding.channel.buId,
        channelId: binding.channel.id, generation: binding.channel.generation, version: credential.version,
      });
      await prisma.channelCredential.update({ where: { channelId: binding.channel.id }, data: {
        nonce: new Uint8Array(envelope.nonce), ciphertext: new Uint8Array(envelope.ciphertext), tag: new Uint8Array(envelope.tag),
      } });
      metaFake.credentialByPhone.set(binding.channel.phoneNumberId!, token);
    }
    const conversationA = await prisma.conversation.create({ data: {
      buId, contact: 'user:tenant-a', contactType: 'PESSOA', status: 'QUEUED',
    } });
    const conversationB = await prisma.conversation.create({ data: {
      buId: tenantB.businessUnit.id, contact: 'user:tenant-b', contactType: 'PESSOA', status: 'QUEUED',
    } });
    const cookieB = await login(app, 'parallel-tenant-b@example.test');
    let arrived = 0;
    let markBothEntered!: () => void;
    let releaseBoth!: () => void;
    const bothEntered = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { markBothEntered = resolve; });
    const held = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releaseBoth = resolve; });
    metaFake.sendHook = async () => { arrived += 1; if (arrived === 2) markBothEntered(); await held; };
    const pendingA = request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversationA.id}/messages`)
      .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({ texto: 'tenant A parallel' }).then((response) => response);
    const pendingB = request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversationB.id}/messages`)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({ texto: 'tenant B parallel' }).then((response) => response);
    await bothEntered;
    expect(metaFake.credentialCalls.map(({ phoneNumberId, accessToken }) => ({ phoneNumberId, accessToken })).sort((a, b) => a.phoneNumberId.localeCompare(b.phoneNumberId)))
      .toEqual([
        { phoneNumberId: channelA.phoneNumberId!, accessToken: tokenA },
        { phoneNumberId: 'parallel-resource-b', accessToken: tokenB },
      ]);
    releaseBoth();
    const [responseA, responseB] = await Promise.all([pendingA, pendingB]);
    expect(responseA.status).toBe(201);
    expect(responseB.status).toBe(201);
    const [messageA, messageB] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.message.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { conversationId: conversationA.id, direction: 'OUT' } }),
      prisma.message.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { conversationId: conversationB.id, direction: 'OUT' } }),
    ]);
    expect(messageA).toMatchObject({ buId, providerResourceIdentityId: bindingA.identity.id, channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', content: 'tenant A parallel' });
    expect(messageB).toMatchObject({ buId: tenantB.businessUnit.id, providerResourceIdentityId: bindingB.identity.id, channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', content: 'tenant B parallel' });
    expect(metaFake.enviados).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([
      { para: 'user:tenant-a', texto: 'tenant A parallel' },
      { para: 'user:tenant-b', texto: 'tenant B parallel' },
    ]));
  });

      .send({ account_id: buId, telefone: phone, texto: 'public outbound during claim' }).expect(201);
    const claimed = await prisma.conversation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: conversation.id } });
    expect(claimed).toMatchObject({ status: 'IN_SERVICE', attendantUserId: expect.any(String), attendantOrigin: 'INTERNO' });
    expect(claimed.attendantName).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('completes five real-PostgreSQL rounds of twenty overlapping sends with one accepted Message each', async () => {
    const operationsPerRound = 20;
    const operationCounts: number[] = [];
    const acceptedCounts: number[] = [];
    const recordedCounts: number[] = [];
    const perOwnedConversationRowCounts: number[][] = [];
    for (let round = 0; round < 5; round += 1) {
      const conversations = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: operationsPerRound }, (_, index) => prisma.conversation.create({ data: {
        buId, contact: `user:opaque-${round}-${index}`, contactType: 'PESSOA', status: 'QUEUED',
      } })));
      let arrivals = 0;
      let markBarrier!: () => void;
      let release!: () => void;
      const barrier = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { markBarrier = resolve; });
      const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
      metaFake.sendHook = async () => {
        arrivals += 1;
        if (arrivals === operationsPerRound) markBarrier();
        await gate;
      };
      const pending = conversations.map((conversation, index) => request(app.getHttpServer())
        .post(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversation.id}/messages`).set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
        .send({ texto: `round ${round} outbound ${index}` }).then((response) => response));
      await barrier;
      release();
      const responses = await Promise.all(pending);
      metaFake.sendHook = null;
      const accepted = responses.filter((response) => response.status === 201).length;
      const recorded = await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId: { in: conversations.map(({ id }) => id) }, direction: 'OUT' } });
      const groupedRows = await prisma.message.groupBy({
        by: ['conversationId'],
        where: { conversationId: { in: conversations.map(({ id }) => id) }, direction: 'OUT' },
        _count: { _all: true },
      });
      const rowCountByConversation = new Map(groupedRows.map((row) => [row.conversationId, row._count._all]));
      const ownedConversationRowCounts = conversations.map(({ id }) => rowCountByConversation.get(id) ?? 0);
      operationCounts.push(responses.length);
      acceptedCounts.push(accepted);
      recordedCounts.push(recorded);
      perOwnedConversationRowCounts.push(ownedConversationRowCounts);
      expect(accepted).toBe(operationsPerRound);
      expect(recorded).toBe(operationsPerRound);
      expect(ownedConversationRowCounts).toEqual(Array(operationsPerRound).fill(1));
    }
    console.log(`[CHANNEL-OUTBOUND-OVERLAP]${JSON.stringify({ repetitions: 5, operationsPerRepetition: operationsPerRound, operationCounts, acceptedCounts, recordedCounts, perOwnedConversationRowCounts, limits: 'Disposable PostgreSQL and provider fake; each distinct owned conversation has exactly one OUT row in this bounded fixture; no same-key exactly-once, capacity, or SLO claim.' })}`);
  });
});

  process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY = Buffer.alloc(32, 17).toString('base64');

    .overrideProvider(EVOLUTION_CLIENT)

    .overrideProvider(TYPEBOT_CLIENT)
    .useValue(typebotFake);
  if (captureQueries) {
    testingModule.overrideProvider(PrismaService).useValue(new PrismaService({ log: [{ emit: 'event', level: 'query' }] }));
  }

  const moduleRef = await testingModule.compile();

  const app = moduleRef.createNestApplication({ bodyParser: false });
  configurarBodyParsers(app as unknown as NestExpressApplication);
  await app.init();
  return { app, prisma: app.get(PrismaService) };
}

/** Cria um usuário com papel escolhido numa BU — para o caso "papel insuficiente". */
export async function criarUsuario(
  prisma: PrismaService,
  mantenedoraId: string,
  buId: string,
  email: string,
  role: 'OWNER' | 'ADMIN' | 'ATENDENTE',
  senha = 'senha-de-teste-1',
): Promise<string> {
  const bcrypt = await import('bcryptjs');
  const user = await prisma.appUser.create({
    data: {
      mantenedoraId,
      name: email,
      email,
      passwordHash: await bcrypt.default.hash(senha, 10),
    },
  });
  await prisma.userBuRole.create({ data: { userId: user.id, buId, role, grantedViaTipo: 'DIRETO' } });
  return user.id;
}

/** Test channel fixture with the same durable ownership and credential invariants as production. */
export async function criarCanalVerificado(
  prisma: PrismaService,
  buId: string,
  type: 'OFICIAL' | 'NAO_OFICIAL',
  externalResourceId: string,
  options: { status?: 'CONECTADO' | 'CONECTANDO' | 'DESCONECTADO'; requiresWindow?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const channel = await prisma.buChannel.create({ data: {
    buId, type, status: options.status ?? 'CONECTADO', requiresWindow: options.requiresWindow ?? type === 'OFICIAL',
    ...(type === 'OFICIAL' ? { phoneNumberId: externalResourceId } : { evolutionInstanceName: externalResourceId }),
    ownNumberVerified: true, verifiedEpoch: 0, providerConnectionState: type === 'OFICIAL' ? 'SUBSCRIBED' : 'CONNECTED',
    receiptVerifiedAt: new Date(),
  } });
  const priorIdentity = await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findUnique({
    where: { provider_externalResourceId: { provider: type, externalResourceId } },
  });
  if (priorIdentity && (priorIdentity.buId !== buId || priorIdentity.currentChannelId)) {
    throw new Error('Fixture resource identity is owned or active elsewhere.');
  }
  const identity = priorIdentity
    ? await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.update({ where: { id: priorIdentity.id }, data: { currentChannelId: channel.id, retiredAt: null, managedLifecycle: true, cleanupState: 'ACTIVE' } })
    : await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.create({ data: {
      provider: type, externalResourceId, buId, currentChannelId: channel.id, managedLifecycle: true, cleanupState: 'ACTIVE',
    } });
  if (type === 'OFICIAL') {
    const keyId = process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID!;
    const key = Buffer.from(process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY!, 'base64');
    const envelope = sealChannelCredential('fixture-scoped-token', keyId, key, {
      purpose: 'active', provider: type, buId, channelId: channel.id, generation: channel.generation, version: 1,
    });
    await prisma.channelCredential.create({ data: {
      channelId: channel.id, provider: type, buId, generation: channel.generation, version: 1,
      keyId, nonce: new Uint8Array(envelope.nonce), ciphertext: new Uint8Array(envelope.ciphertext), tag: new Uint8Array(envelope.tag),
    } });
  }
  return { channel, identity };
}

/** Cria uma Mantenedora pela superfície interna — o caminho real de bootstrap. */
/**
 * Cria a Mantenedora **com o onboarding já concluído**.
 *
 * O bootstrap a cria PENDENTE (ADR-0016 §4), e é assim em produção. Os testes
 * que exercitam o produto vêm depois do wizard; quem exercita o portão é
 * `onboarding.e2e-spec.ts`, que usa `criarMantenedoraPendente`.
 */
export async function criarMantenedora(
  app: INestApplication,
  nome: string,
  email: string,
  senha = 'senha-de-teste-1',
) {
  const r = await criarMantenedoraPendente(app, nome, email, senha);
  const prisma = app.get(PrismaService);
  await prisma.mantenedoraSettings.update({
    where: { mantenedoraId: r.mantenedora.id },
    data: { onboardingConcluido: true },
  });
  return r;
}

export async function criarMantenedoraPendente(
  app: INestApplication,
  nome: string,
  email: string,
  senha = 'senha-de-teste-1',
) {
  const res = await request(app.getHttpServer())
    .post('/api/internal/mantenedoras')
    .set('x-internal-token', TOKEN_INTERNO)
    .set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
    .send({ nome, bu: { nome: `Número da ${nome}`, telefone: '5584999990000' }, owner: { nome: 'Dono', email, senha } })
    .expect(201);
  return res.body as {
    mantenedora: { id: string; nome: string };
    businessUnit: { id: string; nome: string };
    owner: { id: string; email: string };
  };
}

/** Faz login e devolve o cookie de sessão para reusar nas próximas chamadas. */
export async function login(app: INestApplication, email: string, senha = 'senha-de-teste-1'): Promise<string> {
  const res = await request(app.getHttpServer())
    .post('/api/bff/auth/login')
    .set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
    .send({ email, senha })
    .expect(200);
  const setCookie = res.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
  return setCookie[0].split(';')[0];
}

import { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import request from 'supertest';
import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { ChannelCredentialResolver } from '../src/domain/channels/channel-credential-resolver';
import { PrismaService } from '../src/infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { criarCanalVerificado, criarMantenedora, limparBanco, login, metaFake, evolutionFake, subirApp } from './helpers';

function postgresErrorCode(error: unknown): string | undefined {
  if (typeof error !== 'object' || error === null || !('meta' in error)) return undefined;
  const meta = (error as { meta?: unknown }).meta;
  if (typeof meta !== 'object' || meta === null || !('code' in meta)) return undefined;
  const code = (meta as { code?: unknown }).code;
  return typeof code === 'string' ? code : undefined;
}

describe('number onboarding bounded performance and read-scope probes (PostgreSQL)', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  let prisma: PrismaService;

  beforeAll(async () => { ({ app, prisma } = await subirApp(undefined, true)); await app.listen(0, '127.0.0.1'); await limparBanco(prisma); });
  afterAll(async () => { if (prisma) await limparBanco(prisma); await app?.close(); });

  it('captures the attempt exact-lookup plan and bounded response timings (EPS-E2)', async () => {
    const tenant = await criarMantenedora(app, 'EPS lookup', 'eps-lookup@example.test');
    const cookie = await login(app, 'eps-lookup@example.test');
    const key = 'e0000000-e000-4000-8000-000000000001';
    const created = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/api/bff/number-registrations').set('Cookie', cookie)
      .set('x-requested-with', 'eps').set('Idempotency-Key', key)
      .send({ buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, tipo: 'OFICIAL', operation: 'NOVO' }).expect(201);
    const setorId = (await prisma.businessUnit.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: tenant.businessUnit.id }, select: { setorId: true } })).setorId;

      content: `channel list inbound ${index}`, channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA', createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - index * 1000),
    })) });
    const historicalInbound = conversations.flatMap((conversation, conversationIndex) => Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, historyIndex) => ({
      conversationId: conversation.id, buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, direction: 'IN' as const, messageType: 'TEXTO' as const,
      content: `channel list older inbound ${conversationIndex}/${historyIndex}`, channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL' as const, status: 'RECEBIDA' as const,
      createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000 - historyIndex * 1000),
    })));

      .set('x-requested-with', 'eps').send({ nome: 'Channel list EPS key', buIds: [tenant.businessUnit.id] }).expect(201);
    const sqlStatements: string[] = [];
    prisma.$on('query', ({ query }) => sqlStatements.push(query));
    const providerCallsBefore = { meta: metaFake.providerCalls, evolution: evolutionFake.providerCalls };
    const started = performance.now();
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/v1/conversations')
      .query({ account_id: tenant.businessUnit.id, limit: 30 })
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${key.body.chave}`).expect(200);
    const elapsedMs = performance.now() - started;
    const channelQueryCount = sqlStatements.filter((query) => query.includes('FROM "public"."bu_channels"')).length;
    const credentialQueryCount = sqlStatements.filter((query) => query.includes('FROM "public"."channel_credentials"')).length;
    const latestAnyQueryCount = sqlStatements.filter((query) => query.includes('FROM unnest(ARRAY') && query.includes('LIMIT 1') && /UNION ALL/i.test(query)).length;
    const windowQueryCount = sqlStatements.filter((query) => query.includes('FROM unnest(ARRAY') && query.includes('LIMIT 1') && !/UNION ALL/i.test(query)).length;
    const providerCallsAfter = { meta: metaFake.providerCalls, evolution: evolutionFake.providerCalls };
    const ids = conversations.map(({ id }) => id);
    await prisma.$executeRaw`ANALYZE messages`;
    const planRows = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ 'QUERY PLAN': unknown }>>`
      EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON)
      SELECT requested.conversation_id, latest.created_at
      FROM unnest(ARRAY[${Prisma.join(ids)}]::text[]) AS requested(conversation_id)
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT message.created_at
        FROM messages AS message
        WHERE message.conversation_id = requested.conversation_id AND message.direction = 'IN'
        ORDER BY message.created_at DESC, message.id DESC
        LIMIT 1
      ) AS latest
    `;
    const evidence = {
      policy_schema_version: 'pcv-1', lane_id: 'EPS', trigger_result: 'required', trigger_severity: 'medium',
      trigger_reason_code: 'EPS-DATA-PATH-CHANGED', gate_deadline: 'before_local_implemented',
      min_evidence_rule_id: 'EPS-E2', acceptance_rule_id: 'EPS-A2', sample_profile: 'EPS-SP-STRONG',
      access_pattern_classification: 'Public conversation page loads selected BU channels once, official credential metadata once, one bounded latest-any-message projection for returned page IDs, and one separate indexed latest-IN statement when selected bindings require window metadata; no provider credentials are decrypted or probed.',
      pageConversations: response.body.conversations.length,
      historyRowsPerConversation: historicalInbound.length / conversations.length,
      availabilitySample: response.body.conversations.slice(0, 3).map((row: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
        available: row.envio_disponivel, reason: row.motivo_indisponibilidade, windowOpen: row.janela_aberta,
      })),
      queryCounts: { buChannelFindMany: channelQueryCount, channelCredentialFindMany: credentialQueryCount, latestAnyMessageProjection: latestAnyQueryCount, latestInboundWindowProjection: windowQueryCount },
      elapsedMs,
      explainLatestInboundProjection: planRows[0]?.['QUERY PLAN'] ?? null,
      providerCallsBefore: providerCallsBefore,
      providerCallsAfter,
      limits: 'Disposable PostgreSQL and one bounded 30-conversation public page; local query count/plan observation, not a capacity or latency SLO claim.',
    };
    console.log(`[CHANNEL-EPS-EVIDENCE]${JSON.stringify(evidence)}`);
    expect(response.body.conversations).toHaveLength(30);
    expect(response.body.conversations.every((row: { envio_disponivel: boolean }) => row.envio_disponivel), JSON.stringify(evidence.availabilitySample)).toBe(true);
    expect(evidence.queryCounts).toEqual({ buChannelFindMany: 1, channelCredentialFindMany: 1, latestAnyMessageProjection: 1, latestInboundWindowProjection: 1 });
    expect(providerCallsAfter).toEqual(providerCallsBefore);
    expect(planRows[0]?.['QUERY PLAN']).toBeTruthy();
    const planText = JSON.stringify(planRows[0]?.['QUERY PLAN'] ?? null);
    expect(planText).toContain('Limit');
    expect(planText).toMatch(/Index (Only )?Scan|Bitmap Index Scan/);
    expect(planText).toContain('messages_conversation_direction_created_id_idx');
    expect(planText).toContain("direction = 'IN'");
  });

  it('bounds latest-message hydration for a deep public page and reports the executed SQL plan', async () => {
    const tenant = await criarMantenedora(app, 'Channel latest message bound', 'channel-latest-message-bound@example.test');
    const cookie = await login(app, 'channel-latest-message-bound@example.test');
    await criarCanalVerificado(prisma, tenant.businessUnit.id, 'NAO_OFICIAL', 'channel-latest-message-resource', { requiresWindow: false });
    const parentCount = 25;
    const historyRowsPerConversation = 500;
    const conversations = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: parentCount }, (_, index) => prisma.conversation.create({ data: {
      buId: tenant.businessUnit.id,
      contact: `latest-message-bound-${String(index).padStart(3, '0')}`,
      contactType: 'PESSOA',
      status: 'QUEUED',
      lastMessageAt: new Date(Date.now() - index * 1000),
    } })));
    const rows = conversations.flatMap((conversation, conversationIndex) => {
      const baseTime = new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      const historical = Array.from({ length: historyRowsPerConversation - (conversationIndex === 0 ? 2 : 1) }, (_, historyIndex) => ({
        conversationId: conversation.id,
        buId: tenant.businessUnit.id,
        direction: historyIndex % 2 === 0 ? 'IN' as const : 'OUT' as const,
        messageType: 'TEXTO' as const,
        content: `historical ${conversationIndex}/${historyIndex}`,
        channelOrigin: 'NAO_OFICIAL' as const,
        status: historyIndex % 2 === 0 ? 'RECEBIDA' as const : 'ENVIADA' as const,
        createdAt: new Date(baseTime.getTime() + historyIndex * 1000),
      }));
      if (conversationIndex === 0) {
        const tiedAt = new Date(baseTime.getTime() + 10_000_000);
        return [...historical,
          { id: 'latest-message-tie-a', conversationId: conversation.id, buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, direction: 'IN' as const, messageType: 'TEXTO' as const, content: 'older equal-time tie', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL' as const, status: 'RECEBIDA' as const, createdAt: tiedAt },
          { id: 'latest-message-tie-z', conversationId: conversation.id, buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, direction: 'OUT' as const, messageType: 'TEXTO' as const, content: 'newer equal-time tie', channelOrigin: 'NAO_OFICIAL' as const, status: 'ENVIADA' as const, createdAt: tiedAt },
        ];
      }
      const latestAt = new Date(baseTime.getTime() + 10_000_000 + conversationIndex);
      return [...historical, {
        conversationId: conversation.id,
        buId: tenant.businessUnit.id,
        direction: conversationIndex % 2 === 0 ? 'OUT' as const : 'IN' as const,
        messageType: 'TEXTO' as const,
        content: `latest ${conversationIndex}`,
        channelOrigin: 'NAO_OFICIAL' as const,
        status: conversationIndex % 2 === 0 ? 'ENVIADA' as const : 'RECEBIDA' as const,
        createdAt: latestAt,
      }];
    });
    await prisma.message.createMany({ data: rows });
    await prisma.$executeRaw`ANALYZE messages`;
    const key = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/api/bff/integracao/api-keys').set('Cookie', cookie)
      .set('x-requested-with', 'latest-message-bound').send({ nome: 'Latest message bound key', buIds: [tenant.businessUnit.id] }).expect(201);

    const queryEvents: Array<{ query: string; params: string; duration: number }> = [];
    prisma.$on('query', (event) => queryEvents.push(event));
    const eventStart = queryEvents.length;
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/v1/conversations')
      .query({ account_id: tenant.businessUnit.id, limit: 4 })
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${key.body.chave}`).expect(200);
    const endpointQueries = queryEvents.slice(eventStart);
    const nestedMessageQueries = endpointQueries.filter((event) =>
      /FROM\s+"public"\."messages"/i.test(event.query) && /conversation_id/i.test(event.query));
    const latestAnyBatchQueries = endpointQueries.filter((event) =>
      /FROM\s+unnest\(/i.test(event.query) && /LATERAL/i.test(event.query) &&
      /channel_origin/i.test(event.query) && /content/i.test(event.query) && /direction/i.test(event.query));
    const measuredQuery = latestAnyBatchQueries[0] ?? nestedMessageQueries[0];
    const boundParams = measuredQuery ? JSON.parse(measuredQuery.params) as unknown[] : [];
    const explainRows = measuredQuery
      ? await prisma.$queryRawUnsafe<Array<{ 'QUERY PLAN': unknown }>>(
        `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) ${measuredQuery.query}`,
        ...boundParams,
      )
      : [];
    const simpleCandidateIds = conversations.slice(0, response.body.conversations.length).map((conversation) => conversation.id);
    const simpleAllDirectionCandidate = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ 'QUERY PLAN': unknown }>>`
      EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON)
      SELECT requested.conversation_id, latest.id, latest.content, latest.direction, latest.channel_origin
      FROM unnest(ARRAY[${Prisma.join(simpleCandidateIds)}]::text[]) AS requested(conversation_id)
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT message.id, message.content, message.direction, message.channel_origin
        FROM messages AS message
        WHERE message.conversation_id = requested.conversation_id
        ORDER BY message.created_at DESC, message.id DESC
        LIMIT 1
      ) AS latest ON TRUE
    `;
    type PlanNode = {
      'Node Type'?: string; 'Relation Name'?: string; 'Index Name'?: string; 'Actual Rows'?: number; 'Actual Loops'?: number;
      'Shared Hit Blocks'?: number; 'Shared Read Blocks'?: number; 'Rows Removed by Filter'?: number;
      'Rows Removed by Index Recheck'?: number; 'Sort Method'?: string; 'Sort Space Used'?: number; Plans?: PlanNode[];
    };
    const explainDocument = explainRows[0]?.['QUERY PLAN'] as Array<{ Plan?: PlanNode; 'Execution Time'?: number }> | undefined;
    const explainRoot = explainDocument?.[0]?.Plan;
    const flattenPlan = (node: PlanNode | undefined): PlanNode[] => node ? [node, ...(node.Plans ?? []).flatMap(flattenPlan)] : [];
    const messageScanNodes = flattenPlan(explainRoot).filter((node) => node['Relation Name'] === 'messages');
    const sortNodes = flattenPlan(explainRoot).filter((node) => node['Node Type'] === 'Sort');
    const actualMessageRowsVisited = messageScanNodes.reduce((sum, node) =>
      sum + Number(node['Actual Rows'] ?? 0) * Number(node['Actual Loops'] ?? 1), 0);
    const evidence = {
      policy_schema_version: 'pcv-1', finding_id: 'PERF-R3-01', trigger_result: 'required', trigger_severity: 'high',
      trigger_reason_code: 'PUBLIC-LIST-NESTED-MESSAGE-HYDRATION', gate_deadline: 'before_local_implemented',
      pageLimit: 4, returnedParents: response.body.conversations.length, hasLookahead: response.body.truncado,
      parentCount: parentCount, historyRowsPerConversation,
      totalFixtureMessages: rows.length,
      queryCounts: { nestedMessageHydration: nestedMessageQueries.length, boundedLatestMessageBatch: latestAnyBatchQueries.length },
      measuredSqlShape: measuredQuery?.query.replace(/\$\d+/g, '$?') ?? null,
      parameterCount: boundParams.length,
      plan: explainDocument?.[0] ?? null,
      simpleAllDirectionCandidatePlan: simpleAllDirectionCandidate[0]?.['QUERY PLAN'] ?? null,
      messageScanSummary: messageScanNodes.map((node) => ({
        nodeType: node['Node Type'], index: node['Index Name'], actualRows: node['Actual Rows'], actualLoops: node['Actual Loops'],
        rowsRemovedByFilter: node['Rows Removed by Filter'], rowsRemovedByIndexRecheck: node['Rows Removed by Index Recheck'],
        sharedHitBlocks: node['Shared Hit Blocks'], sharedReadBlocks: node['Shared Read Blocks'],
      })),
      sortSummary: sortNodes.map((node) => ({ actualRows: node['Actual Rows'], actualLoops: node['Actual Loops'], method: node['Sort Method'], spaceUsed: node['Sort Space Used'] })),
      actualMessageRowsVisited,
      limits: 'Real public endpoint SQL and EXPLAIN ANALYZE on disposable PostgreSQL; no capacity/latency SLO claim.',
    };
    console.log(`[CHANNEL-LATEST-MESSAGE-EVIDENCE]${JSON.stringify(evidence)}`);

    expect(response.body.conversations).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(response.body.truncado).toBe(true);
    expect(response.body.conversations.map((row: { telefone: string }) => row.telefone))
      .toEqual(conversations.slice(0, 4).map((conversation) => conversation.contact));
    expect(response.body.conversations[0]).toMatchObject({ ultima_mensagem: 'newer equal-time tie', ultima_direcao: 'enviada' });
    expect(response.body.conversations[1]).toMatchObject({ ultima_mensagem: 'latest 1', ultima_direcao: 'recebida' });
    expect(nestedMessageQueries.length + latestAnyBatchQueries.length).toBe(1);
    expect(measuredQuery, JSON.stringify(evidence)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(boundParams).toEqual(conversations.slice(0, response.body.conversations.length).map((conversation) => conversation.id));
    expect(explainRoot, JSON.stringify(evidence)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(actualMessageRowsVisited, JSON.stringify(evidence)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(response.body.conversations.length * 2);
    expect(messageScanNodes, JSON.stringify(evidence)).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(messageScanNodes.every((node) => node['Index Name'] === 'messages_conversation_direction_created_id_idx'), JSON.stringify(evidence)).toBe(true);
    expect(messageScanNodes.every((node) => node['Actual Loops'] === response.body.conversations.length), JSON.stringify(evidence)).toBe(true);
    expect(sortNodes.every((node) => (node['Actual Rows'] ?? 0) <= 2 && node['Actual Loops'] === response.body.conversations.length), JSON.stringify(evidence)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('measures OUT-heavy and OUT-only latest-IN work with actual PostgreSQL rows removed and buffers', async () => {
    const tenant = await criarMantenedora(app, 'Channel history bound', 'channel-history-bound@example.test');
    await criarCanalVerificado(prisma, tenant.businessUnit.id, 'OFICIAL', 'channel-history-bound-resource');
    const pageSize = 500;
    const conversationIds = Array.from({ length: pageSize }, (_, index) => `cb000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(index + 1).padStart(12, '0')}`);
    await prisma.conversation.createMany({ data: conversationIds.map((id, index) => ({
      id, buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, contact: `history-bound-${index}`, contactType: 'PESSOA' as const, status: 'QUEUED' as const,
    })) });
    const conversations = conversationIds.map((id) => ({ id }));
    const oldestInboundAt = new Date(Date.now() - 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const outSuffixLength = 500;
    const outboundHistory = conversations.slice(0, 2).flatMap((conversation, conversationIndex) => Array.from({ length: outSuffixLength }, (_, index) => ({
      conversationId: conversation.id, buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, direction: 'OUT' as const, messageType: 'TEXTO' as const,
      content: `history bound ${conversationIndex}/${index}`, channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL' as const, status: 'ENVIADA' as const,
      createdAt: new Date(oldestInboundAt.getTime() + 60 * 60 * 1000 + index * 1000),
    })));
    await prisma.message.createMany({ data: [
      { conversationId: conversations[0].id, buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO', content: 'older inbound behind OUT suffix', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA', createdAt: oldestInboundAt },
      { conversationId: conversations[2].id, buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO', content: 'equal-time inbound lower id', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA', id: 'cb100000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', createdAt: oldestInboundAt },
      { conversationId: conversations[2].id, buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO', content: 'equal-time inbound higher id', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA', id: 'cb100000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002', createdAt: oldestInboundAt },
      ...outboundHistory,
    ] });
    await prisma.$executeRaw`ANALYZE messages`;
    const ids = conversations.map(({ id }) => id);
    const planRows = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ 'QUERY PLAN': unknown }>>`
      EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON)
      SELECT requested.conversation_id, latest.created_at
      FROM unnest(ARRAY[${Prisma.join(ids)}]::text[]) AS requested(conversation_id)
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT message.created_at
        FROM messages AS message
        WHERE message.conversation_id = requested.conversation_id AND message.direction = 'IN'
        ORDER BY message.created_at DESC, message.id DESC
        LIMIT 1
      ) AS latest
    `;
    const plan = (planRows[0]?.['QUERY PLAN'] as Array<{ Plan?: Record<string, unknown>; 'Execution Time'?: number }> | undefined)?.[0];
    const summarize = (node: Record<string, unknown>): { removed: number; nodes: Array<Record<string, unknown>> } => {
      const children = (node.Plans as Array<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined) ?? [];
      const below = children.map(summarize);
      const loops = Number(node['Actual Loops'] ?? 1);
      const removed = Number(node['Rows Removed by Filter'] ?? 0) * loops + below.reduce((sum, child) => sum + child.removed, 0);
      return { removed, nodes: [node, ...below.flatMap((child) => child.nodes)] };
    };
    const planSummary = plan?.Plan ? summarize(plan.Plan) : { removed: 0, nodes: [] };
    const evidence = {
      finding_id: 'PERF-01', policy_schema_version: 'pcv-1',
      fixture: { conversations: conversations.length, outSuffixLength, hasOlderInbound: true, hasOutOnlyHistory: true, equalTimeTie: true, pageAtMaximum: true },
      actual: {
        rowsRemovedByFilter: planSummary.removed,
        sharedHitBlocks: Number(plan?.Plan?.['Shared Hit Blocks'] ?? 0),
        sharedReadBlocks: Number(plan?.Plan?.['Shared Read Blocks'] ?? 0),
        executionMs: plan?.['Execution Time'] ?? null,
        scanNodes: planSummary.nodes.filter((node) => ['Index Scan', 'Index Only Scan', 'Bitmap Heap Scan', 'Seq Scan'].includes(String(node['Node Type'])))
          .map((node) => ({ type: node['Node Type'], relation: node['Relation Name'], actualRows: node['Actual Rows'], rowsRemovedByFilter: node['Rows Removed by Filter'], loops: node['Actual Loops'], index: node['Index Name'], indexCondition: node['Index Cond'] })),
      },
      plan: planRows[0]?.['QUERY PLAN'] ?? null,

  it('checks index migration timeout rollback on disposable PostgreSQL', async () => {
    const table = 'channel_index_migration_probe';
    await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`CREATE TABLE "${table}" (id text PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id text NOT NULL, direction text NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL)`);
    let releaseBlocker = () => {};
    let blocker = Promise.resolve();
    let blockerFailure: unknown;
    try {
      await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`INSERT INTO "${table}" (id, conversation_id, direction, created_at) SELECT 'probe-' || n, 'conversation-' || (n % 500), CASE WHEN n % 2 = 0 THEN 'IN' ELSE 'OUT' END, now() + n * interval '1 microsecond' FROM generate_series(1, 100000) AS n`);
      let signalBlockerStarted!: () => void;
      const blockerStarted = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { signalBlockerStarted = resolve; });
      const blockerRelease = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releaseBlocker = resolve; });
      blocker = prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(`INSERT INTO "${table}" (id, conversation_id, direction, created_at) VALUES ('held-lock', 'held', 'OUT', now())`);
        signalBlockerStarted();
        await blockerRelease;
      }, { maxWait: 5_000, timeout: 10_000 }).then(() => undefined).catch((error: unknown) => { blockerFailure = error; });

      await blockerStarted;
      const lockAttempt = prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.$executeRaw`SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'`;
        await tx.$executeRaw`SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '60s'`;
        const [settings] = await tx.$queryRaw<Array<{ lock_timeout: string; statement_timeout: string }>>`SELECT current_setting('lock_timeout') AS lock_timeout, current_setting('statement_timeout') AS statement_timeout`;
        expect(settings).toEqual({ lock_timeout: '5s', statement_timeout: '1min' });
        await tx.$executeRaw`SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '100ms'`;
        await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(`CREATE INDEX channel_index_migration_probe_lock_idx ON "${table}" (conversation_id, direction, created_at, id)`);
      }, { maxWait: 5_000, timeout: 5_000 });
      const lockError = await lockAttempt.then(() => null, (error: unknown) => error);
      expect(lockError).not.toBeNull();
      expect(postgresErrorCode(lockError), JSON.stringify({ code: postgresErrorCode(lockError), prismaCode: (lockError as { code?: string } | null)?.code })).toBe('55P03');
      releaseBlocker();
      await blocker;
      if (blockerFailure) throw blockerFailure;

      const timeoutAttempt = prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.$executeRaw`SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'`;
        await tx.$executeRaw`SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '60s'`;
        const [settings] = await tx.$queryRaw<Array<{ lock_timeout: string; statement_timeout: string }>>`SELECT current_setting('lock_timeout') AS lock_timeout, current_setting('statement_timeout') AS statement_timeout`;
        expect(settings).toEqual({ lock_timeout: '5s', statement_timeout: '1min' });
        await tx.$executeRaw`SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '1ms'`;
        await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(`CREATE INDEX channel_index_migration_probe_timeout_idx ON "${table}" (conversation_id, direction, created_at, id)`);
      }, { maxWait: 5_000, timeout: 5_000 });
      const timeoutError = await timeoutAttempt.then(() => null, (error: unknown) => error);
      expect(timeoutError).not.toBeNull();
      expect(postgresErrorCode(timeoutError), JSON.stringify({ code: postgresErrorCode(timeoutError), prismaCode: (timeoutError as { code?: string } | null)?.code })).toBe('57014');
      const remainingIndexes = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ indexname: string }>>`
        SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes
        WHERE schemaname = current_schema() AND tablename = ${table}
          AND indexname IN ('channel_index_migration_probe_lock_idx', 'channel_index_migration_probe_timeout_idx')
      `;
      const [{ count }] = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ count: bigint }>>`SELECT count(*) AS count FROM "${Prisma.raw(table)}"`;
      const baselineWriteStarted = performance.now();
      await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`INSERT INTO "${table}" (id, conversation_id, direction, created_at) SELECT 'baseline-' || n, 'conversation-' || (n % 500), CASE WHEN n % 2 = 0 THEN 'IN' ELSE 'OUT' END, now() + n * interval '1 microsecond' FROM generate_series(100001, 101000) AS n`);
      const baselineWriteMs = performance.now() - baselineWriteStarted;
      await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`CREATE INDEX channel_index_migration_probe_write_idx ON "${table}" (conversation_id, direction, created_at, id)`);
      const indexedWriteStarted = performance.now();
      await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`INSERT INTO "${table}" (id, conversation_id, direction, created_at) SELECT 'indexed-' || n, 'conversation-' || (n % 500), CASE WHEN n % 2 = 0 THEN 'IN' ELSE 'OUT' END, now() + n * interval '1 microsecond' FROM generate_series(101001, 102000) AS n`);
      const indexedWriteMs = performance.now() - indexedWriteStarted;
      const [{ indexBytes }] = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ indexBytes: bigint }>>`
        SELECT pg_relation_size(index_class.oid) AS "indexBytes"
        FROM pg_index AS index_row
        JOIN pg_class AS table_class ON table_class.oid = index_row.indrelid
        JOIN pg_class AS index_class ON index_class.oid = index_row.indexrelid
        JOIN pg_namespace AS namespace_row ON namespace_row.oid = table_class.relnamespace
        WHERE namespace_row.nspname = current_schema() AND table_class.relname = ${table}
          AND index_class.relname = 'channel_index_migration_probe_write_idx'
      `;
      const evidence = {
        finding_id: 'PERF-01', lock_timeout: '5s', statement_timeout: '60s',
        test_acceleration: { lock_timeout: '100ms', statement_timeout: '1ms', note: 'short disposable probes; exact migration values separately observed above' },
        sqlstates: { lock: postgresErrorCode(lockError), statement: postgresErrorCode(timeoutError) },
        rowsAfterAbortedDDL: Number(count), survivingIndexesAfterAbort: remainingIndexes.length,
        writeObservation: { batchRowsEach: 1_000, withoutIndexMs: baselineWriteMs, withIndexMs: indexedWriteMs, indexBytes: Number(indexBytes), note: 'same disposable table; bounded single-sample observation, no capacity/SLO threshold' },
      };
      console.log(`[CHANNEL-MIGRATION-ROLLBACK-EVIDENCE]${JSON.stringify(evidence)}`);
      expect(remainingIndexes).toHaveLength(0);
      expect(Number(count)).toBe(100001);
      expect(Number(indexBytes)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    } finally {
      releaseBlocker();
      await blocker;
      await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "${table}"`);
    }
  });

    expect(selected).toMatchObject({ ultima_direcao: 'recebida', envio_disponivel: true, janela_expira_em: null });
    expect(windowQueries, JSON.stringify(evidence)).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(latestAnyQueries, JSON.stringify(evidence)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('runs five clients through six scoped channel reads each with zero provider fan-out (RLS-SP-L)', async () => {
    const actors: Array<{ buId: string; cookie: string }> = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < 5; index += 1) {
      const tenant = await criarMantenedora(app, `RLS tenant ${index}`, `rls-${index}@example.test`);
      await criarCanalVerificado(prisma, tenant.businessUnit.id, 'OFICIAL', `rls-resource-${index}`);
      actors.push({ buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, cookie: await login(app, `rls-${index}@example.test`) });
    }
    const metaCallsBeforeCalibration = metaFake.providerCalls;
    await metaFake.numerosDaWaba('123456789', 'fixture-scoped-token');
    expect(metaFake.providerCalls).toBe(metaCallsBeforeCalibration + 1);
    const externalProviderCallsAtReadStart = { meta: metaFake.providerCalls, evolution: evolutionFake.providerCalls };
    const observed: Array<{ client: number; ownReads: number; foreignReads: number }> = [];
    const started = performance.now();
    const clientReadGroups = actors.map(async (actor, client) => {
      const foreignBuId = actors[(client + 1) % actors.length].buId;
      for (let read = 0; read < 3; read += 1) {
        const own = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/bff/business-units/${actor.buId}/channels`).set('Cookie', actor.cookie);
        expect(own.status, JSON.stringify(own.body)).toBe(200);
        expect(own.body.canais).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(own.body.canais[0]).toMatchObject({ type: 'OFICIAL', ownNumberVerified: true });
        const foreign = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/bff/business-units/${foreignBuId}/channels`).set('Cookie', actor.cookie);
        expect(foreign.status, JSON.stringify(foreign.body)).toBe(404);
        expect(foreign.body.code).toBe('NAO_ENCONTRADO');
      }
      observed.push({ client, ownReads: 3, foreignReads: 3 });
    });
    await Promise.all(clientReadGroups);
    const elapsedMs = performance.now() - started;
    const providerCallsAfter = { meta: metaFake.providerCalls, evolution: evolutionFake.providerCalls };
    const evidence = {
      policy_schema_version: 'pcv-1', lane_id: 'RLS', trigger_result: 'recommended', trigger_severity: 'medium',

      min_evidence_rule_id: 'RLS-E1', acceptance_rule_id: 'RLS-A1', stage_profile_observed: 'RLS-SP-L',
      clients: observed.length, readsPerClient: 6, totalScopeChecks: observed.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.ownReads + row.foreignReads, 0), observed,
      thresholds: { ownBuReadStatus: 200, foreignTenantReadStatus: 404, providerCallsDuringListing: 0 },
      providerCalls: { calibration: 'one fixture Meta number-list operation was detected before the read stage', before: externalProviderCallsAtReadStart, after: providerCallsAfter, duringReadDelta: { meta: providerCallsAfter.meta - externalProviderCallsAtReadStart.meta, evolution: providerCallsAfter.evolution - externalProviderCallsAtReadStart.evolution } }, elapsedMs,
      metrics_summary: 'Five authenticated clients ran concurrently; each completed three sequential own-BU and three sequential foreign-tenant reads; all instrumented Meta/Evolution operations remained unchanged during channel listing.',
      limits: 'One bounded local PostgreSQL stage; not a capacity, latency SLO, or provider load claim.',
    };
    console.log(`[RLS-EVIDENCE]${JSON.stringify(evidence)}`);
    expect(evidence.totalScopeChecks).toBe(30);
    expect(providerCallsAfter).toEqual(externalProviderCallsAtReadStart);
  });
});

      return json(res, 200, { configured: true });

      onboarding.meta.sendMode = data.mode;
      return json(res, 200, { mode: onboarding.meta.sendMode });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/select-evolution') {
      const conversation = await prisma.conversation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: data.conversationId } });
      const channel = await prisma.buChannel.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { buId: conversation.buId, type: 'NAO_OFICIAL' } });

      const message = await prisma.message.create({ data: {
        conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO',
        content: 'ingress fixture selects Evolution', channelOrigin: 'NAO_OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA',
        externalId: `fixture-ingress-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
        providerResourceIdentityId: identity.id, createdAt: new Date(Date.now() + 60_000),
      } });

    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/late-tie') {
      const conversation = await prisma.conversation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: data.conversationId } });
      const message = await prisma.message.create({ data: {
        id: String(data.id), conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId,
        direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO', content: 'inserção empatada tardia',
        channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA', createdAt: new Date(data.createdAt),
      } });
      return json(res, 201, { id: message.id });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/revoke') {
      await prisma.userBuRole.deleteMany({ where: { userId: data.userId, buId: data.businessUnitId } });
      return json(res, 200, { revoked: true });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/burst') {
      const conversation = await prisma.conversation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: data.conversationId } });
      const count = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(data.count ?? 120), 500));
      const base = new Date(data.createdAt ?? Date.now());
      await prisma.message.createMany({ data: Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({
        conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO',
        content: `burst ${i + 1}`, channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA',
        createdAt: new Date(base.getTime() + i),
      })) });
      return json(res, 201, { count });
    }
    return json(res, 404, { error: 'not found' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    return json(res, 500, { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) });
  }
});
server.listen(fixturePort, '127.0.0.1', () => console.log(`timeline fixtures listening on 127.0.0.1:${fixturePort}`));
process.on('SIGTERM', () => server.close(() => prisma.$disconnect().finally(() => process.exit(0))));
process.on('SIGINT', () => server.close(() => prisma.$disconnect().finally(() => process.exit(0))));

import { expect, test, type APIRequestContext, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

const FIXTURES = 'http://127.0.0.1:3101';

async function seed(request: APIRequestContext, includeEvolution = false, count = 3) {
  const response = await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/seed`, { data: { count, includeEvolution } });
  expect(response.status()).toBe(201);
  return response.json() as Promise<{
    email: string; password: string; businessUnitId: string; conversationId: string;
    otherConversationId: string; otherBusinessUnitId: string;
  }>;
}

async function loginAndOpen(page: Page, fixture: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof seed>>, messages = 3) {
  await page.context().clearCookies();
  await page.goto('/login');
  await page.getByLabel('E-mail').fill(fixture.email);
  await page.getByLabel('Senha').fill(fixture.password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Entrar' }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/inbox$/);
  await page.getByLabel('Business Unit').selectOption(fixture.businessUnitId);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cliente Timeline' }).click();
  await expect(page.locator('.bolha')).toHaveCount(messages);
}

test.describe('Channel outbound pela Inbox com BFF e PostgreSQL reais', () => {
  test('envia por Meta, mantém rascunho em ACK sem ID e bloqueia conversa ambígua', async ({ page, request }) => {
    const fixture = await seed(request);
    await loginAndOpen(page, fixture);
    const composer = page.getByPlaceholder('Escreva uma resposta');
    await composer.fill('resposta oficial de teste');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar' }).click();
    await expect(page.locator('.bolha').filter({ hasText: 'resposta oficial de teste' })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(composer).toHaveValue('');

    await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/send-mode`, { data: { mode: 'unknown' } });
    await composer.fill('rascunho não reenviado');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar' }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toContainText('aceitou o envio sem confirmar o ID externo');
    await expect(composer).toHaveValue('rascunho não reenviado');

    const ambiguous = await seed(request, true, 0);
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    await page.goto('/login');
    await page.getByLabel('E-mail').fill(ambiguous.email);
    await page.getByLabel('Senha').fill(ambiguous.password);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Entrar' }).click();
    await page.getByLabel('Business Unit').selectOption(ambiguous.businessUnitId);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cliente Timeline' }).click();
    await expect(page.getByText('Esta conversa ainda não tem um canal definido. Aguarde uma mensagem recebida para responder.')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar' })).toBeDisabled();
  });

  test('seleciona Evolution pela última origem e descarta resposta atrasada após troca A→B→A', async ({ page, request }) => {
    const fixture = await seed(request, true);
    await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/select-evolution`, { data: { conversationId: fixture.conversationId } });
    await loginAndOpen(page, fixture, 4);
    const composer = page.getByPlaceholder('Escreva uma resposta');
    await composer.fill('resposta não oficial de teste');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar' }).click();
    await expect(page.locator('.bolha').filter({ hasText: 'resposta não oficial de teste' })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(composer).toHaveValue('');

    let liberar!: () => void;
    let iniciou!: () => void;
    const continua = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { liberar = resolve; });
    const solicitacao = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { iniciou = resolve; });
    const holdReply = (url: URL) => url.pathname === `/api/bff/conversations/${fixture.conversationId}/messages`;
    const holdResponse = async (route: import('@playwright/test').Route) => {
      if (route.request().method() !== 'POST') return route.continue();
      const response = await route.fetch();
      iniciou();
      await continua;
      await route.fulfill({ response });

    await page.evaluate((pathname) => {
      type BodyReadState = {
        started: number;
        settled: number;
        processed: number;
        completion: Promise<void>;
        resolveCompletion: () => void;
        originalFetch: typeof window.fetch;
      };
      const w = window as typeof window & { __stcon06BodyRead?: BodyReadState };
      let resolveCompletion!: () => void;
      const state: BodyReadState = {
        started: 0,
        settled: 0,
        processed: 0,
        completion: new Promise<void>((resolve) => { resolveCompletion = resolve; }),
        resolveCompletion: () => resolveCompletion(),
        originalFetch: window.fetch,
      };
      const nativeFetch = window.fetch.bind(window);
      window.fetch = async (input, init) => {
        const requestUrl = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input);
        const method = init?.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET');
        const response = await nativeFetch(input, init);
        if (method === 'POST' && new URL(requestUrl, window.location.href).pathname === pathname) {
          const nativeText = response.text.bind(response);
          response.text = () => {
            state.started += 1;
            return nativeText().then((body) => {
              state.settled += 1;
              // A browser task runs after this promise and the awaiting api.ts / responder
              // microtasks, including the generation fence and draft decision.
              window.setTimeout(() => {
                state.processed += 1;

              return body;

        return response;
